summary: Manchester United plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its fourth quarter and full fiscal 2026 results press release, dated 23 September 2026. Fiscal 2026 revenue reached a record £677.6 million, operating profit was £22.6 million versus a prior-year loss of £18.4 million, adjusted EBITDA hit a record £216.4 million (up 18.4%), and the full-year loss was £43.0 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation; watch for margin guidance and Champions League revenue cadence.
